patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,125 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.current_frame = 1
+        self.frame_rolls = []  # Rolls in the current frame
+        self.frames = []  # Completed frames
+    
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        # Validation
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Negative roll is invalid")
+        
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        
+        # Check if game is already complete
+        if len(self.frames) == 10:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        
+        # Add roll to current frame
+        self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        
+        # Handle frame completion logic
+        if self.current_frame < 10:
+            # Regular frames (1-9)
+            if pins == 10:  # Strike
+                self.frames.append(self.frame_rolls[:])
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+                self.current_frame += 1
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:  # Two rolls completed
+                if sum(self.frame_rolls) > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                self.frames.append(self.frame_rolls[:])
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+                self.current_frame += 1
+        else:
+            # 10th frame - special rules
+            # Can have up to 3 rolls
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 1:
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] == 10:  # First roll is strike
+                    # Continue to second roll
+                    pass
+                else:
+                    # First roll wasn't strike, need second roll
+                    pass
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+                # Check if we need a third roll
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 or sum(self.frame_rolls[:2]) == 10:
+                    # Strike or spare - need third roll
+                    pass
+                else:
+                    # Open frame - game over
+                    self.frames.append(self.frame_rolls[:])
+                    self.frame_rolls = []
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:
+                # Third roll completed - game over
+                # Validate the 10th frame
+                first_roll = self.frame_rolls[0]
+                second_roll = self.frame_rolls[1]
+                third_roll = self.frame_rolls[2]
+                
+                if first_roll == 10:  # First roll was strike
+                    if second_roll == 10:  # Second roll was also strike
+                        # Valid - three strikes
+                        pass
+                    else:
+                        if second_roll + third_roll > 10 and second_roll != 10:
+                            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                elif first_roll + second_roll == 10:  # First two rolls were spare
+                    # Third roll can be anything up to 10
+                    if third_roll > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                else:
+                    # This shouldn't happen - we shouldn't have gotten to 3 rolls
+                    raise ValueError("Should not be able to roll third ball")
+                
+                self.frames.append(self.frame_rolls[:])
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+    
+    def score(self):
+        # Check if game is complete
+        if len(self.frames) < 10:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        # Score each of the first 9 frames
+        for frame_num in range(9):
+            if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+                raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+            
+            frame_score = 0
+            first_roll = self.rolls[roll_index]
+            
+            if first_roll == 10:  # Strike
+                frame_score = 10
+                if roll_index + 1 < len(self.rolls):
+                    frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                    frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                roll_index += 1
+            else:
+                second_roll = self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                frame_score = first_roll + second_roll
+                
+                if frame_score == 10:  # Spare
+                    if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                        frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                
+                roll_index += 2
+            
+            total_score += frame_score
+        
+        # Score the 10th frame
+        if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        # For the 10th frame, just sum all remaining rolls
+        while roll_index < len(self.rolls):
+            total_score += self.rolls[roll_index]
+            roll_index += 1
+        
+        return total_score
